items.title: What the Energy Display Changed
items.topic: how a public energy display influenced electricity use in a school building
items.benefit: visible daily data helped students and staff connect ordinary actions with changes in electricity consumption
items.challenge: lower use on some days reflected weather and room schedules as well as deliberate conservation
items.lesson: feedback can encourage better choices, but interpreting results requires separating behavior from other changing conditions
items.topicJa: 校舎の電力使用量を見える化する表示が行動に与えた影響
items.benefitJa: 毎日の数値を見せることで日常の行動と電力消費の変化を結びつけやすくなること
items.challengeJa: 使用量の減少には節電だけでなく天候や教室利用予定も影響していたこと
items.lessonJa: フィードバックは行動改善に役立つが結果の解釈では他の変化する条件も分けて考える必要がある

items.title: The Cost of a Faster Lunch Line
items.topic: a school redesigning cafeteria service to shorten waiting times while preserving choice
items.benefit: a simplified serving line allowed more students to receive lunch quickly and increased time available for eating
items.challenge: removing slower options improved average speed but reduced choices for students with particular preferences
items.lesson: an efficiency measure should be judged not only by average time saved but also by who loses useful options
items.topicJa: 選択肢を保ちながら給食の待ち時間を短縮する学校の試み
items.benefitJa: 配膳を簡素化すると多くの生徒が早く受け取り食事時間を増やせること
items.challengeJa: 時間のかかる選択肢を減らすと平均速度は上がるが特定の好みを持つ生徒の選択肢が減ること
items.lessonJa: 効率化は平均的な時間短縮だけでなく誰が有用な選択肢を失うかも含めて評価すべき

items.title: When More Trees Are Not the Whole Answer
items.topic: a neighborhood comparing tree planting with other ways to reduce summer heat
items.benefit: trees can provide shade, improve streets, and lower surface temperatures over time
items.challenge: young trees need years to grow and may not provide enough immediate relief in the hottest locations
items.lesson: long-term environmental measures can be combined with short-term responses instead of being treated as competing solutions
items.topicJa: 夏の暑さ対策として植樹と他の方法を比較する地域
items.benefitJa: 木は日陰を作り街路環境を改善し長期的に表面温度を下げられること
items.challengeJa: 若木が育つには年月が必要で最も暑い場所ですぐ十分な効果を出せないこと
items.lessonJa: 長期的な環境対策と短期的な対応は競合させず組み合わせることができる

items.title: The Missing Voices in a Successful Survey
items.topic: why a high response rate did not guarantee that a town survey represented every resident fairly
items.benefit: the survey collected many responses and revealed clear concerns about transport and public spaces
items.challenge: older residents and people with limited internet access were less likely to use the online form
items.lesson: a large sample can still be biased when the method makes participation easier for some groups than others
items.topicJa: 回答数の多い町の調査でもすべての住民を公平に代表できない理由
items.benefitJa: 多くの回答から交通や公共空間への明確な関心を把握できたこと
items.challengeJa: 高齢者やインターネット利用が限られる人はオンラインフォームに回答しにくかったこと
items.lessonJa: 標本数が多くても参加方法が一部の集団に有利なら偏りは残りうる
